substantive_evidence.claim: The course covers Internet layering, addressing, intra- and inter-domain routing, reliable transport, congestion control, and TCP, UDP, IP, DNS, and HTTP protocols.
The guide places the course under the computer-networks navigation category and links an official course site.
The guide links the course textbook at textbook.cs168.io.
